description: This PHP source file defines the CustomFieldAPI class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It implements RESTful endpoints to manage custom fields, including CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) for custom employee fields. The class integrates with various services and models to handle API requests related to custom fields, including validation rules, request handling, and data serialization.

classes.name: CustomFieldAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class managing custom employee fields in the HRM system, providing CRUD operations and related functionalities with validation and data serialization.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific custom field by ID and returns it as a resource result.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all custom fields with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new custom field, ensuring the limit of 10 fields is not exceeded.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified custom fields if they are not in use.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new custom field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an existing custom field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting custom fields.

methods.name: setCustomField
methods.description: Sets properties of a CustomField object based on request parameters.

methods.name: saveCustomField
methods.description: Persists a CustomField object via the custom field service.
